title: About Akcelport
lede: One of India's leading makers of electrical components and assemblies, exporting for more than 35 years.
story: Akcelport Industries is a manufacturer of electrical components and assemblies with expertise in control panel components, switchboard components, wires, cables and wire management, connection and grounding products, and industrial hardware.

Our roots are in non-ferrous casting, extrusion and machining of ferrous and non-ferrous metals. That experience lets us design, develop and make components to customer requirements, from production planning right through to delivery.

We are an export based company. For more than 35 years we have supplied mature markets in the Americas, Europe, the Gulf, the Far East and Australasia, and we keep adding products and markets by listening to what the industry asks for.

quality.quote: Quality is not just controlled. It is built in.
body: Akcelport has a well-documented quality policy that starts and ends with the customer. We take a stringent, quality conscious approach to developing and delivering our products, so that we can:
It is our endeavour to build a culture of Total Quality, where continuous improvement of the 3Ps (People, Processes and Product) becomes a way of life.
commitments: Ensure maximum professional and self satisfaction
quality.process: Our products are made of high quality raw material by skilled labour under the strict supervision of qualified staff. We keep improving design and production so that every product is elegant, aesthetic and, above all, functionally satisfying.

global.title: Get ahead, stay ahead
body: Our experience is forged by more than 35 years of service to customers in several parts of the world, including the USA, Australia, New Zealand and European countries.

We are expanding both our industry-specific range of products and our global presence, by understanding what the industry demands and delivering first-time quality and customer satisfaction. We keep working to meet the local needs of markets across the globe.
